france-and-england-in-north-america-part: Francis Parkman's magisterial history reaches Count Frontenac — the bold governor who saved New France and defied the English. Parkman's narrative sweeps from Quebec to the frontier with unmatched vividness. Part of the greatest history of colonial North America ever written.

Parkman's second volume follows the Jesuit missionaries into the wilderness of New France — their heroism, their martyrdoms, their relations with the Hurons and Iroquois. Written with novelistic power and deep research, it remains the great English account of the black-robed pioneers.
expositions-of-holy-scripture-genesis-ex: Alexander Maclaren, Manchester's great Baptist preacher, opens up the books from Genesis to Numbers with deep learning and a warm heart for God's word. His clear, godly teaching fed Bible readers for generations on both sides of the sea. A trusted guide for study, preaching, and quiet devotion.
